# antigravity-priority v1.4.1

## 更新内容 / Release Notes

### 中文

**v1.4.1 修复了管理端 `/schedule/status` 接口在 CPA 宿主代理下返回 404 的问题。**

#### 🐛 缺陷修复
- **注册 `/schedule/status` 管理路由**：在运行时插件注册表（`registerManagement`）中补充注册 `GET /schedule/status` 路由，确保调度状态轮询与刷新请求能够正确通过 CPA 宿主转发至插件处理。

### English

**v1.4.1 fixes a 404 error on the `/schedule/status` management endpoint when proxied through the CPA host.**

#### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- **Register `/schedule/status` Management Route**: Registers `GET /schedule/status` in the runtime plugin route table (`registerManagement`) so schedule status polling and refresh requests are properly forwarded by the CPA host.
